## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One Critical defect needs fixing before merge. The rewrite of `requirement_proven` makes an empty criteria list count as proven, which goes against the PR description's statement that "No behavior change is intended." The typing and `log.warning` changes look mechanical in every hunk this review checked. The `itemgetter` sort key behaves the same as the lambda it replaces.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — `requirement_proven([])` now returns `True`; before this change it returned `False`. With no criteria, `sum(...)` is `0` and `len(criteria)` is `0`, so `proven == len(criteria)` passes. The removed line `return bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)` returned `False` here because of the `bool(criteria)` guard. The function still logs "requirement has no criteria" at line 10 and then reports success anyway. To fix it, keep the empty-input guard, for example `return bool(criteria) and proven == len(criteria)` or the original `all(...)` form. Also add `assert not requirement_proven([])` to `tests/test_handlers.py:17`, which currently tests only a non-empty passing list and a non-empty failing list. — A requirement with no criteria now passes the release-review proof check instead of failing it. This weakens a release gate even though the PR description says behavior is unchanged, and no test would catch it.

## Strengths
- `app/handlers/h040_sorting.py:8` swaps `lambda row: row["name"]` for `itemgetter("name")`. The two give the same ordering and raise the same `KeyError` on a missing key, and `tests/test_handlers.py:13` covers the change.

## Not reviewed
- This review read the hunks for `app/handlers/h000_records.py` and `app/handlers/h001_records.py` line by line. For the other 178 record handlers (`app/handlers/h002_records.py` through `app/handlers/h179_records.py`), it checked the changes by counting patterns across the whole diff instead of reading each hunk. All 1,080 `def step_N` signature changes, all 1,080 `log.warn`→`log.warning` changes and all 181 removed `from typing import Dict, List` lines account for every added or removed line except those in `h040_sorting.py`, `h091_requirements.py` and `review.txt`.
- The repository has no `pyproject.toml`, `setup.cfg`, `setup.py` or `.python-version`, so this review could not confirm which Python version is supported. The built-in generic annotations (`list[dict[str, int]]`) need Python 3.9 or later.
